name: Anirban De
eyebrow: Head of Risk Management & Control Assurance · Uber Technologies
heroSummary: 14+ years building enterprise-scale risk management, governance, and security compliance programs — turning fragmented security processes into AI-driven platforms that sharpen executive decision-making, accelerate remediation, and reduce enterprise risk.
about: I lead enterprise technology risk and cybersecurity programs at global scale — with deep expertise across Enterprise Risk Management, GRC, Third-Party Risk, Security Engineering, AI Risk, Compliance, and Cybersecurity Maturity. I've built a track record as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, leading cross-functional initiatives across global engineering organizations to transform how enterprises see, prioritize, and act on risk.

experience.role: Head of Risk Management & Control Assurance
bullets: Lead strategy and execution for Risk Central, Uber's AI-native Enterprise Risk Intelligence Platform, unifying risk across users, SaaS, AI agents, endpoints, insider threat, third parties, and data assets into a single decision-making platform.
Built Uber's first enterprise-wide technology risk lifecycle, standardizing risk taxonomy, scoring, governance, and reporting across engineering organizations.
Designed AI-driven Third-Party Risk Intelligence, assessing 23,000+ vendors, identifying Uber's most critical suppliers, and introducing Vendor Blast Radius analysis.
Transformed Enterprise Issue Management with risk-based prioritization and executive governance — reducing the security issue backlog by 70% and improving remediation velocity by 2–3×.
Established Uber's Enterprise Security Exception Management program, deploying AI agents that automate exception triage and governance, reducing Device Trust exceptions by 40%.
Led enterprise compliance initiatives across PSD2, ISO, and SOX — increasing automated assurance coverage by 30% and cutting audit preparation effort by 40%.
Directed Uber's NIST Cybersecurity Maturity program, improving organizational maturity from 2.4 toward 4.0 through enterprise-wide assessments and strategic investment planning.
Lead global cross-functional teams delivering initiatives across Risk Intelligence, Third-Party Risk, Security Assurance, Governance, Compliance, and AI Risk.
Led enterprise technology risk and cyber transformation programs for Fortune 500 organizations across financial services, healthcare, and retail.
Designed IT risk frameworks, continuous control monitoring, cloud governance, and executive reporting that improved audit readiness and operational resilience.
Served as trusted advisor to executive leadership on risk strategy, control effectiveness, regulatory compliance, and technology modernization.
Delivered cybersecurity, IT risk, SOX, NIST, and regulatory compliance programs for Fortune 1000 organizations.
Developed enterprise risk frameworks, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and governance models that improved security posture and reduced audit findings.
